g.text: Mission-step contract, pack skill and glossary descriptor schemas — decided design (ADR-0049, ADR-0050)
Kept as a kind (ADR-0050 d5). File moves into the bundle:
today's suffix is kept if it differs (d5).
gates and GateBinding are removed (follow-ups); a binding migrates
to a guard on a lifecycle transition (ADR-0050 d12).
«an item inside a context, not an artifact (d3)»
id : string (kebab-case, unique in the context)
surface becomes name; synonyms_to_avoid becomes avoid;
Only a clash on the same term: URN is a conflict (d12, d13).
Yellow «pending» / [pending …]: decided in the cited ADR,
but the cited open question is not ruled.
